# Finance & Assurance Local Analytical Handoff

This is a synthetic, governed, data-only analytical handoff.

Start with `handoff-manifest.json` for the snapshot identity and file registry.
Read `limitations.json` before using any dataset or measure specification.
Use `source-model/warehouse/finance-assurance.duckdb` read-only.
Use `examples/starter-queries.sql` for exploration and
`examples/reconciliation-queries.sql` for the registered C-001 and CT-1 proofs.

The package does not contain a dashboard, financial model, semantic model,
forecast, valuation, DAX, TMDL, or report.
